messages:
carl: FYI escalation from Acme — their Analytics dashboards go empty when they apply Region=eu-west + Model=redwood-7b + Version=v2. Raw API shows traffic and tokens, console charts show 0. Customer asks for urgent triage. Repro steps below and they included a screenshot link: https://redwood.internal/attachments/esc-382/snap1.png

emily: Can you paste the console URL and example org_id + timeframe? also does this happen if they pick other regions?

carl: URL (redacted): https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/ORG-ACME/analytics?region=eu-west&model=redwood-7b&version=v2&range=24h
Repro (very quick):
1) Open Analytics -> Time range: last 24h
2) Filters: Region: eu-west, Model: redwood-7b, Version: v2
3) Observe charts are empty; raw events in Logs tab show tokens for the same window.
Customer reported this started after the version selector change last week.

raj: looking at backend logs for that org_id I see filter normalizer warnings around the same times. snippet:
```
[2024-06-02T15:12:23Z] WARN filter_normalizer: unknown filter key 'version' for 'model' -> dropping 'version' param for request org=ORG-ACME user=svc-analytics
[2024-06-02T15:12:23Z] DEBUG filter_normalizer: received params: {region: 'eu-west', model: 'redwood-7b', model_version: 'v2'}
```
Basically the frontend is sending `model_version` (snake_case) in some flows and the normalizer only accepts `variant` / `version` / `model:alias` in other mappings. So the version gets dropped and we fall back to model alias which matches all versions -> charts look empty for that narrow filter.

emily: nice find. Reproduced locally: frontend sometimes encodes the multi-select as `model_version` when the version dropdown is used separately. Quick mitigation: frontend can send combined `model` param like `redwood-7b@v2` which already works. I'll prepare a hotpatch to accept `model_version` and normalize it to `variant` on the server as well.

ana: (product) we need to notify the customer about a safe workaround and give ETA. assign to @emily and @raj for the fix + rollout. Also put a short incident note in #incidents.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: staging deploy in 10 minutes for hotfix branch `fix/filter-normalizer-model-version`, prod after verification.

carl: Customer tried the workaround (selected model dropdown item `redwood-7b@v2`) and confirms charts populated again. They want ETA for proper fix and a note about rollback risk.

emily: ETA ~4 hours for hotfix + smoke tests in staging, will update thread. Will include a config toggle to allow both `model_version` and `variant` until clients converge.

raj: after hotfix I'll add a unit test to cover the snake_case -> camelCase normalization and update the docs for the filters API.

carl: ack, thanks. I'll update the customer with workaround and ETA. :thumbsup:
